events.title: A pod, and somebody waving
events.text: One escape pod, turning end over end on the last of its cells. Where its name was painted there is bare plate, scraped down by somebody with time on their hands. The beacon has pinged so long it has worn the same four notes into a tune. Through the cracked canopy a woman in an orange mechanic's suit, red hair tied up in a rag, has both arms over her head and is waving them the way you wave at a ship you have been waiting for a very long time.

choices.text: Open the pod and bring her aboard.

outcomes.text: She tumbles out of the hatch still talking. "Ada. Mechanic. Eleven weeks in there, I counted the rivets twice. I can fix anything you have and I will, I promise, just let me hold a wrench." She looks round the ship as if it were a cathedral. If there is a spare bunk she takes it; if not, she will sleep on the floor and call it luxury. Free of charge: she is only glad to see anyone. Before she has both boots on the deck she presses the pod's recorder into your hand. "The beacon. Four notes, that's all it does. Keep it, I'm sick of the tune. Not sick enough to leave it behind."

choices.text: Wish her luck and leave her to her tune.

outcomes.text: You lift a hand. She goes on waving a little longer than she should, then stops, and the four notes of the beacon follow you out of range.
